title: 25 March 1964: Filming: A Hard Day's Night
content:
There were four consecutive days of filming at the Scala Theatre in London for The Beatles’ first film A Hard Day’s Night. This was the third day.

Page last updated: 23 March 2018

Also on this day...

  • 2003: Paul McCartney live: Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, Paris
  • 2003: Album release: Ringo Rama by Ringo Starr
  • 1999: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Horseshoe Casino Tunica, Tunica Resorts
  • 1976: Wings live: Rotterdam Ahoy, Rotterdam
  • 1975: Mixing: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings
  • 1973: Television: James Paul McCartney
  • 1970: Ringo Starr is interviewed for the BBC’s Scene And Heard
  • 1970: Mixing: For You Blue, Teddy Boy, Two Of Us
  • 1969: John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s first bed-in for peace: Amsterdam
  • 1966: The Beatles’ ‘butcher’ photo session
  • 1965: Filming: Help!
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
